results.description:
### Full Stack Developer – TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js

**Location:** Near LeamingtonSpa, Warwickshire (Hybrid – 3 days on site)  
**Job type:** Permanent, Full-time  
**Salary:** £38,000 – £45,000 + benefits

We’re hiring a **Full StackDeveloper** for an established, growing UK software company whose design andmanufacturing software is used by creative businesses worldwide. You’ll workacross the whole stack on a production customer platform, with code review onevery change and a clear path to becoming its lead developer.

### About the role

Alongside its desktop products,the business runs a growing set of web services: customer accounts, licensing,subscriptions and cloud compute. You’ll focus on the customer account andlicensing platform, built with **Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL andAWS**.

You’ll start on well-scopedfeatures and take on more ownership as your experience grows. You’ll gettechnical mentoring from the Infrastructure Tech Lead and work with the desktopsoftware team and experienced external development and QA partners. As theplatform grows, you’ll also contribute to backend compute and AI services andhelp rebuild the company website.

### What you’ll be doing

- Building features across the **Next.js** frontend and **NestJS** API
- Designing and evolving the **PostgreSQL**schema, including migrations and query performance
- Building APIs used by the company’s desktopapplications
- Deploying and monitoring services on **AWS**,with a focus on reliability, security and cost
- Writing automated tests and maintaining CI/CDpipelines
- Handling customer and account data securely and inline with GDPR

### What you’ll bring

- Experience building web applications in **TypeScriptor JavaScript**, whether commercially, on placement or throughsubstantial personal projects
- **React**, with some exposure to **Next.js**
- Back-end development in **Node.js**, buildingREST APIs (NestJS, Express or similar)
- **SQL** and relational databases, ideallyPostgreSQL
- **Git**, and a habit of writing tests

### Nice to have

- NestJS or Next.js in production
- AWS (ECS/Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront), Terraform orDocker
- Integrating AI models, or some Python
- OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, Stripe or licensing systems
- Interest in CAD/CAM or design software

### Tech stack:

TypeScript,Next.js, React, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, Terraform, Docker

### What’s on offer

- £40,000 – £45,000 salary
- 8% contributory pension and private healthcare
- 25 days’ holiday + bank holidays, plus additionaltime off at Christmas
- Hybrid working: 3 days on site, 2 from home
- A clear progression path to lead developer on aproduction platform
- Access to in-house CNC machines and 3D printers

results.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer (React, Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL)
results.description:
Our black belt specialists are leaders in their domains, serving as digital champions, delivery focused experts, top tier security professionals, AI thought leaders, and engineering best practice advocates.

As 1 of Australias fastest growing software businesses, Software at Scale delivers cutting edge technology solutions that power mission critical platforms. We solve complex engineering challenges at scale, driving quality, performance, and resilience through the strength of our people.

## The Role and The Challenge

We are seeking an exceptional, highly energetic, and proactive **Staff Full Stack Engineer** to lead technical delivery and architectural strategy across our most critical programs. You will act as an elite technical partner, injecting momentum into complex enterprise environments and eliminating operational inertia from day 1.

If you are content with picking up standard tickets, writing boilerplate code, or waiting for rigid top down specifications, this is not the role for you. We want a true technical leader who brings high energy, practices respectful thought leadership, and takes complete architectural ownership of ultra fast and highly performant full stack systems. You will step into a high trust and fully empowered environment where you will set engineering baselines, guide multiple squads, and own end to end production operations inside AWS.

Access to AI Tooling: We believe in removing friction so you can focus on solving hard problems. You will have full access to enterprise AI tooling, including Claude Code, to assist you in accelerating code generation, refactoring, and pipeline management.

## Key Responsibilities

- Thought Leadership and Squad Uplift: Act as an energetic domain leader, energising engineering squads, providing constructive architectural guidance with empathy, and raising engineering standards across client engagements.
- End to End Architecture: Design, build, and scale production grade systems across the entire stack using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js, establishing architectural standards for engineering squads.
- Modernisation and Asset Reuse: Spearhead the practical modernisation of existing legacy platforms, intelligently building upon and reusing existing enterprise technology assets rather than pushing for unnecessary ground up rewrites.
- System Design and Production Operations: Own comprehensive system design, applying 12 factor app principles and rigorous production safety to ensure your software is robust, observable, and fully prepared to operate reliably in high volume environments.
- Production Support and Blind Debugging: Maintain absolute visibility over production software where direct server access is restricted, leveraging correlation IDs, structured JSON logging, APM tracing, and dead letter queues.
- GraphQL Mastery and High Performance Frontend: Architect robust GraphQL APIs on the backend and build lightning fast, responsive interfaces using advanced Next.js features and strict state management.
- DevOps and AWS Infrastructure: Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or TeamCity, deploying containerised workloads on AWS and managing secure configurations via dedicated secret vaults.

## What You Bring (Attitude and Mindset)

- Consultant Identity: You present as a trusted technical partner who takes complete ownership of business outcomes, eliminates team friction, and drives solutions rather than waiting for guidance.
- High Energy Thought Leader: You bring infectious enthusiasm, strategic vision, and hands on technical leadership to the team, acting as a true champion of engineering best practices.
- Proactive Problem Solver: You do not wait to be handed answers. When faced with broad or open ended problems, you pause, clarify boundaries and constraints, and collaborate to map out execution paths.
- Master of Constraints: You respect legacy design decisions and regulatory limitations while pragmatically navigating constraints to keep project momentum high.

## What You Bring (Technically)

- Staff Level Expertise: Proven commercial experience operating at a Staff Engineer level within modern and high performing engineering teams, leading architectural direction and mentoring technical talent.
- Full Stack TypeScript Mastery: Deep and hands on expertise writing production grade TypeScript on both the client and the server within monorepo architectures.
- Frontend & Backend Excellence: Mandatory, proven experience building complex single page applications using React and Next.js, paired with scalable backend services in Node.js and custom GraphQL implementations.
- Production Operations & DevOps Mastery: Extensive commercial experience deploying and operating workloads on AWS, managing CI/CD pipelines, containerisation with Docker, and rigorous production monitoring.
- Comprehensive Testing Discipline: Deep commitment to the testing pyramid, writing clean test code like production code, implementing integration tests, and maintaining contract testing standards.
- Tooling Fluency: A practical and delivery focused mindset on how to leverage modern AI tools to assist in software engineering and problem solving.

## What We Offer

- The chance to work for 1 of Australias fastest growing and most innovative software businesses.
- Access to the latest AI tooling to assist you in achieving your technical goals.
- Meaningful and hands on engineering work solving truly interesting and complex problems.
- Clear growth pathways from Staff to Principal and beyond.
- A low ceremony and delivery focused environment that values engineers who own outcomes.
- Competitive remuneration and benefits.

results.description:
### Job Description

Our ‘black belt’ specialists are leaders in their domains: digital champions, delivery-focused experts, top-tier security professionals, AI thought leaders, and engineering best practice advocates.

With a global footprint and deep local insight, Software at Scale delivers cutting-edge technology solutions that power mission-critical platforms. We solve complex engineering challenges at scale, driving quality, performance, and resilience through the strength of our people.

**Empower Your Career**

We’re seeking a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** to play a key role in delivering high-quality, scalable systems across our most important programmes. This mandate focuses on building an ultra-fast, highly performant modern web application using **Next.js, React, TypeScript, and GraphQL** within a highly secure environment.

This role is hands-on and delivery-oriented, requiring true end-to-end ownership. You will have the scope to heavily influence both frontend and backend architecture, establish performance baselines, and lead by example within our engineering teams. We are looking for a highly proactive engineer who thrives when navigating legacy constraints and who takes the initiative to find solutions rather than waiting to be given the answer.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **End-to-End Architecture:** Design and build production-grade, highly performant systems across the entire stack using **TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js**.
- **Proactive Problem Solving:** Take absolute ownership of technical challenges. Autonomously investigate issues, propose robust solutions, and drive them to completion without waiting for detailed, top-down instructions.
- **Complex Integrations & Legacy Constraints:** Architect resilient software solutions that successfully navigate strict enterprise constraints, including seamless integration with legacy systems and complex, disparate third-party APIs.
- **GraphQL Mastery:** Architect and implement robust **GraphQL** APIs on the backend (resolvers, schemas, query optimisation) and seamlessly consume them on the frontend with modern caching strategies.
- **High-Performance Frontend:** Ensure optimal Core Web Vitals and lightning-fast render times by leveraging advanced Next.js features (SSR, SSG, client-side routing).
- **Secure Development:** Architect full-stack solutions that adhere to the strictest security standards, working safely within a highly secure enterprise environment to protect sensitive data and prevent vulnerabilities at every layer.
- **Ecosystem Management:** Build and maintain systems within complex monorepo architectures, ensuring clean separation of concerns and shared tooling.
- **DevOps & Testing:** Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or TeamCity. Implement robust full-stack test automation practices, including containerised workflows using Docker.
- **Cloud-Native Deployment:** Leverage AWS-native services to deploy reliable, scalable applications.
- **AI Tooling Adoption:** Champion the adoption of GenAI and agentic tools where they tangibly improve engineering productivity, code quality, or system capability.

**What You Bring**

- **Senior-Level Expertise:** Proven experience operating at a Senior Engineer level within modern, high-performing engineering teams.
- **Self-Starter Mindset:** A highly proactive approach to engineering. You are known for hunting down answers, researching architectural trade-offs independently, and bringing fully formed solutions to the table.
- **Constraint-Driven Design:** Demonstrated ability to design modern software around legacy systems and execute highly complex API integrations securely and reliably.
- **Full-Stack TypeScript Mastery:** Deep, hands-on expertise writing production-grade **TypeScript** on both the client and the server.
- **Frontend Excellence:** Mandatory, proven experience building complex, high-performance applications using **React and Next.js**.
- **Backend & API Design:** Extensive commercial experience building scalable backend services in **Node.js** and designing/implementing **GraphQL** APIs from scratch.
- **Security & Performance:** A strong track record of building performant applications (optimising bundle sizes, rendering strategies, database queries) specifically within highly regulated or secure environments.
- **Infrastructure & CI/CD:** Experience deploying and operating workloads on AWS, managing CI/CD pipelines, and working with Docker.
- **AI Fluency:** Exposure to GenAI and agentic engineering tools, with a practical, delivery-focused mindset on how to use them safely.

**What We Offer**

- Meaningful, hands-on engineering work across complex, enterprise-grade platforms.
- Clear growth pathways from Senior to Staff and beyond.
- A low-ceremony, delivery-focused environment that values engineers who proactively own outcomes.
- Competitive remuneration and benefits.
- The opportunity to work alongside highly experienced engineers on challenging, high-impact systems.

Were looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer with deep hands-on experience in building secure, scalable healthcare software. In this role, you will take ownership of the design, development and delivery of enterprise-grade applications on our healthcare technology platforms. This is an ideal role for an experienced engineer who can drive technical decisions, own complex integrations and deliver production-quality solutions across a full-stack environment spanning modern web technologies, cloud infrastructure and healthcare data standards.

**Responsibilities :**

\- Design and develop robust full-stack applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript and Firebase/Google Cloud services.

\- Take ownership of end-to-end feature delivery: from architecture decisions and design through to production deployment.

\- Build and maintain FHIR-compliant integrations with Google Cloud Healthcare API, including resource operations, data sync pipelines and streaming exports to BigQuery.

\- Work on secure, role-based access control (RBAC) across Next.js middleware, Firebase Security Rules, and Firebase Functions.

\- Develop and maintain Firebase Functions for serverless backend logic, Firestore triggers, Pub/Sub subscribers and scheduled jobs.

\- Ensure data integrity across Firestore and FHIR datastores, including pipelines to BigQuery for analytics and reporting.

\- Integrate and maintain AI/ML workflows using Google Genkit and Gemini AI, with strict attention to data privacy and PHI handling.

\- Monitor application health using GCP Cloud Logging, Error Reporting and Cloud Trace; investigate and resolve production issues proactively.

\- Conduct thorough code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, patterns and best practices.

\- Write and maintain automated tests including E2E tests using Playwright to ensure software quality across multiple user roles.

\- Work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, QA and Operations to support smooth project execution.

\- Contribute to continuous integration and deployment processes (CI/CD) to improve development and release efficiency.

\- Ensure all development adheres to HIPAA compliance requirements and healthcare data security standards; maintain up-to-date technical documentation.

**Required Skills:**

**Frontend Technologies:**

\- Framework: Next.js 15.0 with React 18.3

\- Language: TypeScript for type-safe development

\- UI Components: ShadCN UI with Radix UI primitives

\- Styling: Tailwind CSS with custom design system

\- State Management: React Hooks and Context API

\- Form Handling: React Hook Form with Zod validation

**Backend Technologies :**

\- Authentication: Firebase Authentication with NextAuth.js and custom claims-based RBAC

\- Database: Firebase Firestore (NoSQL) with Security Rules authoring

\- FHIR Integration: Google Cloud Healthcare API FHIR R4 resource operations and data exchange

\- AI/ML Platform: Google Genkit with Gemini AI for clinical workflow automation

\- Cloud Functions: Firebase Functions HTTP, Firestore, Auth, Pub/Sub, and Scheduled triggers

\- File Storage: Firebase Storage for documents and media

\- Data & Analytics: BigQuery for FHIR data analytics; streaming and batch export pipelines from Google Cloud Healthcare API

\- Messaging: GCP Pub/Sub for event-driven architectures and FHIR change notifications

\- Observability: GCP Cloud Logging, Error Reporting, and Cloud Trace for monitoring and debugging

**You should apply if you have :**

\- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

\- 7 to 9 years of hands-on experience in software development with a strong focus on full-stack web technologies.

\- Deep proficiency in Next.js, React and TypeScript for building production-grade web applications, including App Router patterns and Server Components.

\- Strong experience with Firebase Authentication, NextAuth.js and implementing custom claims-based RBAC across Next.js middleware, Firebase Security Rules, and Cloud Functions.

\- Hands-on experience with Firebase Firestore, including data modelling for NoSQL, Security Rules authoring, and working with consistency patterns.

\- Good experience with Google Cloud Healthcare API for FHIR R4 compliant data exchange, including resource CRUD operations, search, and batch/streaming export to BigQuery.

\- Practical experience working with BigQuery for healthcare analytics, including navigating FHIR-structured schemas and writing analytical SQL.

\- Hands-on experience with Firebase Functions across multiple trigger types: HTTP, Firestore, Auth, Pub/Sub, and Scheduled.

\- Experience with UI development using ShadCN UI, Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS, and form handling with React Hook Form and Zod validation.

\- Experience building event-driven architectures using GCP Pub/Sub, including FHIR change notification pipelines and async processing - good to have.

\- Experience integrating Google Genkit and Gemini AI into production applications, with strong understanding of responsible AI use and PHI handling in clinical contexts - good to have.

\- Proficiency with GCP observability tools - Cloud Logging, Error Reporting, and Cloud Trace for proactive monitoring and production issue diagnosis - good to have.

\- Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines; experience with Firebase App Hosting or similar deployment platforms is a plus.

\- Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance requirements and experience designing HIPAA-compliant software, including PHI handling, audit logging and data security best practices - good to have.

\- Excellent problem-solving skills, ability to work independently on complex systems, and strong written and verbal technical communication

results.title: Full Stack Developer (Next.js / TypeScript)
results.description:
Шукаємо full stack розробника для створення нового вебпродукту з нуля до продакшену. Ви будете єдиним розробником на проєкті перші місяці: від схеми бази до деплою.

Кого ми шукаємо  
У вас є комерційний досвід із TypeScript і React/Next.js від 3 років  
Ви працювали з Next.js App Router не як із SPA: серверний рендеринг, server actions, кешування  
PostgreSQL — пишете SQL руками, читаєте плани запитів, ведете міграції  
Ви застосовуєте на практиці принципи SOLID, KISS, DRY, ООП та design patterns  
Ваш рівень компетенції дозволяє приймати та обґрунтовувати технічні рішення — поруч не буде тимліда, який зробить це за вас  
У вас є досвід роботи з інструментами: Git, Docker  
Ви маєте за плечима запуск продукту, а не лише окремі фічі  
Буде плюсом досвід із: Telegram Bot API та Mini Apps, PostGIS або іншими геоданими, MapLibre/Leaflet, SSR і SEO-рендерингом, обробкою персональних даних

Наш стек  
Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, Drizzle або Prisma, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, Telegram Mini Apps, MapLibre GL, Docker

Що ви будете робити  
Розробляти MVP з нуля: схема даних, бекенд, фронтенд, деплой  
Зробити одну кодову базу для трьох поверхонь: публічний сайт із серверним рендерингом та індексацією в Google, Mini App усередині Telegram і веб-кабінет клієнта  
Реалізувати геочастину: геокодування адрес із кешуванням, пошук за відстанню на PostGIS, мапа з кластеризацією точок  
Побудувати кабінет, у якому одна людина керує сотнями записів на десятках адрес — масовими діями, а не поштучно  
Підняти інфраструктуру проєкту: деплой, моніторинг, бекапи  
Брати участь в обговоренні обсягу: ТЗ написане й детальне, але це живий документ, і ваші аргументи щодо складності впливають на те, що потрапить у першу версію

Що ми пропонуємо  
Продукт з нуля, а не підтримка чужої спадщини: усі архітектурні рішення ваші  
Мінімум бюрократії. Адекватність у менеджменті  
Повністю віддалена робота  
Готові макети мобільних екранів і написане ТЗ — не доведеться вгадувати, що робити  
Справедива заробітня плата з переглядом  
Оформлення через ФОП або гіг-контракт
